```julia
using Flux

const _CONTACT_THRESHOLD::Float64 = 8.0
const _CONTACT_EPSILON::Float64 = 1e-3

struct DistogramHeadConfig
    first_break::Float64
    last_break::Float64
    num_bins::Int64
    DistogramHeadConfig(; first_break=2.3125, last_break=21.6875, num_bins=64) = new(first_break, last_break, num_bins)
end

struct DistogramHead
    config::DistogramHeadConfig
    global_config
    name::String
    half_logits_layer
end

function DistogramHead(config::DistogramHeadConfig, global_config; name="distogram_head")
    half_logits_layer = Dense(0 => config.num_bins; init=global_config.final_init)
    DistogramHead(config, global_config, name, half_logits_layer)
end

function (model::DistogramHead)(batch, embeddings::Dict{String, Any}; return_distogram::Bool=false)
    pair_act = embeddings["pair"]
    seq_mask = Bool.(batch.token_features.mask)
    pair_mask = seq_mask[:, None] .* seq_mask[None, :]
    left_half_logits = model.half_logits_layer(pair_act)
    right_half_logits = left_half_logits
    logits = left_half_logits .+ permutedims(right_half_logits, (3, 2, 1))
    probs = softmax(logits, dims=3)
    breaks = range(model.config.first_break, model.config.last_break, length=model.config.num_bins - 1)
    bin_tops = vcat(breaks, breaks[end] + (breaks[end] - breaks[end-1]))
    threshold = _CONTACT_THRESHOLD + _CONTACT_EPSILON
    is_contact_bin = 1.0 .* (bin_tops .<= threshold)
    contact_probs = zeros(size(probs, 1), size(probs, 2))
    for i in 1:size(probs, 1)
        for j in 1:size(probs, 2)
            contact_probs[i, j] = sum(probs[i, j, :] .* is_contact_bin)
        end
    end
    contact_probs = pair_mask .* contact_probs
    return_dict = Dict("bin_edges" => breaks, "contact_probs" => contact_probs)
    if return_distogram
        return_dict["distogram"] = logits
    end
    return return_dict
end
```

```julia
using Dates

function validate_fold_input(fold_input)
    for (i, chain) in enumerate(fold_input.protein_chains)
        if isnothing(chain.unpaired_msa)
            error("Protein chain $(i + 1) is missing unpaired MSA.")
        end
        if isnothing(chain.paired_msa)
            error("Protein chain $(i + 1) is missing paired MSA.")
        end
        if isnothing(chain.templates)
            error("Protein chain $(i + 1) is missing Templates.")
        end
    end
    for (i, chain) in enumerate(fold_input.rna_chains)
        if isnothing(chain.unpaired_msa)
            error("RNA chain $(i + 1) is missing unpaired MSA.")
        end
    end
end

function featurise_input(
    fold_input,
    ccd,
    buckets::Union{Vector{Int}, Nothing};
    ref_max_modified_date::Union{Date, Nothing}=nothing,
    conformer_max_iterations::Union{Int, Nothing}=nothing,
    resolve_msa_overlaps::Bool=true,
    verbose::Bool=false
)
    validate_fold_input(fold_input)
    pipeline_config = WholePdbPipelineConfig(
        buckets=buckets,
        ref_max_modified_date=ref_max_modified_date,
        conformer_max_iterations=conformer_max_iterations,
        resolve_msa_overlaps=resolve_msa_overlaps
    )
    data_pipeline = WholePdbPipeline(config=pipeline_config, ccd=ccd)
    batches = []
    for rng_seed in fold_input.rng_seeds
        featurisation_start_time = time()
        if verbose
            println("Featurising data with seed $(rng_seed).")
        end
        batch = process_item(
            data_pipeline,
            fold_input=fold_input,
            ccd=ccd,
            random_state=MersenneTwister(rng_seed),
            random_seed=rng_seed
        )
        if verbose
            elapsed = time() - featurisation_start_time
            println("Featurising data with seed $(rng_seed) took $(round(elapsed, digits=2)) seconds.")
        end
        push!(batches, batch)
    end
    return batches
end
```

```julia
using Random
using LinearAlgebra

const SIGMA_DATA = 16.0

function random_rotation(key)
    v0, v1 = randn(2, 3)
    e0 = v0 ./ max(1e-10, norm(v0))
    v1 = v1 .- e0 .* dot(v1, e0)
    e1 = v1 ./ max(1e-10, norm(v1))
    e2 = cross(e0, e1)
    return hcat(e0, e1, e2)'
end

function random_augmentation(rng_key, positions, mask)
    rotation_key, translation_key = split_key(rng_key)
    center = mask_mean(mask[:, :, newaxis], positions, dims=(1, 2), keepdims=true, eps=1e-6)
    rot = random_rotation(rotation_key)
    translation = randn(rng, 3)
    positions_centered = positions .- center
    augmented_positions = zeros(size(positions))
    for i in axes(positions, 1)
        for j in axes(positions, 2)
            augmented_positions[i, j, :] = rot * positions_centered[i, j, :]
        end
    end
    augmented_positions = augmented_positions .+ reshape(translation, 1, 1, 3)
    return augmented_positions .* mask[:, :, newaxis]
end

function noise_schedule(t; smin=0.0004, smax=160.0, p=7)
    return SIGMA_DATA * (smax^(1/p) + t * (smin^(1/p) - smax^(1/p)))^p
end

struct ConditioningConfig
    pair_channel::Int
    seq_channel::Int
    prob::Float64
    ConditioningConfig(; pair_channel=128, seq_channel=384, prob=0.8) = new(pair_channel, seq_channel, prob)
end

struct SampleConfig
    steps::Int
    gamma_0::Float64
    gamma_min::Float64
    noise_scale::Float64
    step_scale::Float64
    num_samples::Int
    SampleConfig(; steps=200, gamma_0=0.8, gamma_min=1.0, noise_scale=1.003, step_scale=1.5, num_samples=1) = new(steps, gamma_0, gamma_min, noise_scale, step_scale, num_samples)
end

struct DiffusionHeadConfig
    eval_batch_size::Int
    eval_batch_dim_shard_size::Int
    conditioning::ConditioningConfig
    eval::SampleConfig
    transformer
    DiffusionHeadConfig(; eval_batch_size=5, eval_batch_dim_shard_size=5, conditioning=ConditioningConfig(), eval=SampleConfig(), transformer=nothing) = new(eval_batch_size, eval_batch_dim_shard_size, conditioning, eval, transformer)
end

mutable struct DiffusionHead
    config::DiffusionHeadConfig
    global_config
    name::String
    pair_cond_initial_projection
    pair_cond_initial_norm
    single_cond_initial_norm
    single_cond_initial_projection
    noise_embedding_initial_projection
    noise_embedding_initial_norm
    single_cond_embedding_projection
    single_cond_embedding_norm
    output_norm
end

function DiffusionHead(config::DiffusionHeadConfig, global_config; name="diffusion_head")
    DiffusionHead(
        config, global_config, name,
        nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing
    )
end

function _conditioning(model::DiffusionHead, batch, embeddings, noise_level, use_conditioning)
    single_embedding = use_conditioning .* embeddings["single"]
    pair_embedding = use_conditioning .* embeddings["pair"]
    rel_features = create_relative_encoding(
        seq_features=batch.token_features,
        max_relative_idx=32,
        max_relative_chain=2
    )
    rel_features = convert(eltype(pair_embedding), rel_features)
    features_2d = cat(pair_embedding, rel_features, dims=3)
    pair_cond = model.pair_cond_initial_projection(
        model.pair_cond_initial_norm(features_2d)
    )
    for idx in 0:1
        pair_cond = pair_cond .+ transition_block(
            pair_cond, 2, model.global_config, name="pair_transition_$(idx)"
        )
    end
    target_feat = embeddings["target_feat"]
    features_1d = cat(single_embedding, target_feat, dims=2)
    single_cond = model.single_cond_initial_norm(features_1d)
    single_cond = model.single_cond_initial_projection(single_cond)
    noise_embedding = noise_embeddings(sigma_scaled_noise_level=noise_level / SIGMA_DATA)
    single_cond = single_cond .+ model.noise_embedding_initial_projection(
        model.noise_embedding_initial_norm(noise_embedding)
    )
    for idx in 0:1
        single_cond = single_cond .+ transition_block(
            single_cond, 2, model.global_config, name="single_transition_$(idx)"
        )
    end
    return single_cond, pair_cond
end

function (model::DiffusionHead)(positions_noisy, noise_level, batch, embeddings, use_conditioning)
    trunk_single_cond, trunk_pair_cond = _conditioning(
        model,
        batch=batch,
        embeddings=embeddings,
        noise_level=noise_level,
        use_conditioning=use_conditioning
    )
    sequence_mask = batch.token_features.mask
    atom_mask = batch.predicted_structure_info.atom_mask
    act = positions_noisy .* atom_mask[:, :, newaxis]
    act = act ./ sqrt(noise_level^2 + SIGMA_DATA^2)
    enc = atom_cross_att_encoder(
        token_atoms_act=act,
        trunk_single_cond=embeddings["single"],
        trunk_pair_cond=trunk_pair_cond,
        config=model.config,
        global_config=model.global_config,
        batch=batch,
        name="diffusion"
    )
    act = enc.token_act
    act = Float32.(act)
    act = act .+ model.single_cond_embedding_projection(
        model.single_cond_embedding_norm(trunk_single_cond)
    )
    act = Float32.(act)
    trunk_single_cond = Float32.(trunk_single_cond)
    trunk_pair_cond = Float32.(trunk_pair_cond)
    sequence_mask = Float32.(sequence_mask)
    transformer = Transformer(model.config.transformer, model.global_config)
    act = transformer(
        act=act,
        single_cond=trunk_single_cond,
        mask=sequence_mask,
        pair_cond=trunk_pair_cond
    )
    act = model.output_norm(act)
    position_update = atom_cross_att_decoder(
        token_act=act,
        enc=enc,
        config=model.config,
        global_config=model.global_config,
        batch=batch,
        name="diffusion"
    )
    skip_scaling = SIGMA_DATA^2 / (noise_level^2 + SIGMA_DATA^2)
    out_scaling = noise_level * SIGMA_DATA / sqrt(noise_level^2 + SIGMA_DATA^2)
    return (skip_scaling .* positions_noisy .+ out_scaling .* position_update) .* atom_mask[:, :, newaxis]
end

function sample(denoising_step, batch, key, config::SampleConfig)
    mask = batch.predicted_structure_info.atom_mask
    function apply_denoising_step(carry, noise_level)
        key, positions, noise_level_prev = carry
        key, key_noise, key_aug = split_random(key, 3)
        positions = random_augmentation(
            rng_key=key_aug, positions=positions, mask=mask
        )
        gamma = config.gamma_0 * (noise_level > config.gamma_min ? 1 : 0)
        t_hat = noise_level_prev * (1 + gamma)
        noise_scale = config.noise_scale * sqrt(t_hat^2 - noise_level_prev^2)
        noise = noise_scale .* randn(size(positions))
        positions_noisy = positions .+ noise
        positions_denoised = denoising_step(positions_noisy, t_hat)
        grad = (positions_noisy .- positions_denoised) ./ t_hat
        d_t = noise_level - t_hat
        positions_out = positions_noisy .+ config.step_scale .* d_t .* grad
        return (key, positions_out, noise_level), positions_out
    end
    num_samples = config.num_samples
    noise_levels = noise_schedule.(range(0, 1, length=config.steps + 1))
    key, noise_key = split_key(key)
    positions = randn(num_samples, size(mask)..., 3)
    positions = positions .* noise_levels[1]
    init = (
        split_keys(key, num_samples),
        positions,
        fill(noise_levels[1], num_samples)
    )
    result = foldl(noise_levels[2:end], init=init) do carry, noise_level
        apply_denoising_step(carry, noise_level)
    end
    _, positions_out, _ = result
    final_dense_atom_mask = repeat(mask[newaxis, :, :], outer=(num_samples, 1, 1))
    return Dict("atom_positions" => positions_out, "mask" => final_dense_atom_mask)
end
```

```julia
using Random

struct PairformerConfig
    block_remat::Bool
    remat_block_size::Int
    single_transition
    single_attention
    num_layer::Int
    PairformerConfig(; block_remat=false, remat_block_size=8, single_transition=nothing, single_attention=nothing, num_layer=48) = new(block_remat, remat_block_size, single_transition, single_attention, num_layer)
end

struct EvoformerConfig
    max_relative_chain::Int
    msa_channel::Int
    seq_channel::Int
    max_relative_idx::Int
    num_msa::Int
    pair_channel::Int
    pairformer::PairformerConfig
    per_atom_conditioning
    template
    msa_stack
    EvoformerConfig(; max_relative_chain=2, msa_channel=64, seq_channel=384, max_relative_idx=32, num_msa=1024, pair_channel=128, pairformer=PairformerConfig(), per_atom_conditioning=nothing, template=nothing, msa_stack=nothing) = new(max_relative_chain, msa_channel, seq_channel, max_relative_idx, num_msa, pair_channel, pairformer, per_atom_conditioning, template, msa_stack)
end

mutable struct Evoformer
    config::EvoformerConfig
    global_config
    name::String
    position_activations_layer
    left_single_layer
    right_single_layer
    bond_embedding_layer
    single_activations_layer
    prev_single_embedding_layer
    prev_single_embedding_layer_norm
    prev_embedding_layer
    prev_embedding_layer_norm
end

function Evoformer(config::EvoformerConfig, global_config; name="evoformer")
    Evoformer(
        config, global_config, name,
        nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing, nothing
    )
end

function _relative_encoding(model::Evoformer, batch, pair_activations)
    rel_feat = create_relative_encoding(
        seq_features=batch.token_features,
        max_relative_idx=model.config.max_relative_idx,
        max_relative_chain=model.config.max_relative_chain
    )
    rel_feat = convert(eltype(pair_activations), rel_feat)
    pair_activations = pair_activations .+ model.position_activations_layer(rel_feat)
    return pair_activations
end

function _seq_pair_embedding(model::Evoformer, token_features, target_feat)
    left_single = model.left_single_layer(target_feat)[:, newaxis]
    right_single = model.right_single_layer(target_feat)[newaxis, :]
    dtype = eltype(left_single)
    pair_activations = left_single .+ right_single
    num_residues = size(pair_activations, 1)
    @assert size(pair_activations) == (num_residues, num_residues, model.config.pair_channel)
    mask = token_features.mask
    pair_mask = (mask[:, newaxis] .* mask[newaxis, :])
    pair_mask = convert(dtype, pair_mask)
    @assert size(pair_mask) == (num_residues, num_residues)
    return pair_activations, pair_mask
end

function _embed_bonds(model::Evoformer, batch, pair_activations)
    num_tokens = size(batch.token_features.token_index, 1)
    contact_matrix = zeros(num_tokens, num_tokens)
    tokens_to_polymer_ligand_bonds = batch.polymer_ligand_bond_info.tokens_to_polymer_ligand_bonds
    gather_idxs_polymer_ligand = tokens_to_polymer_ligand_bonds.gather_idxs
    gather_mask_polymer_ligand = prod(tokens_to_polymer_ligand_bonds.gather_mask, dims=2)
    gather_mask_polymer_ligand = convert(eltype(gather_idxs_polymer_ligand), gather_mask_polymer_ligand)[:, newaxis]
    gather_idxs_polymer_ligand = gather_idxs_polymer_ligand .* gather_mask_polymer_ligand
    tokens_to_ligand_ligand_bonds = batch.ligand_ligand_bond_info.tokens_to_ligand_ligand_bonds
    gather_idxs_ligand_ligand = tokens_to_ligand_ligand_bonds.gather_idxs
    gather_mask_ligand_ligand = prod(tokens_to_ligand_ligand_bonds.gather_mask, dims=2)
    gather_mask_ligand_ligand = convert(eltype(gather_idxs_ligand_ligand), gather_mask_ligand_ligand)[:, newaxis]
    gather_idxs_ligand_ligand = gather_idxs_ligand_ligand .* gather_mask_ligand_ligand
    gather_idxs = vcat(gather_idxs_polymer_ligand, gather_idxs_ligand_ligand)
    for i in axes(gather_idxs, 1)
        contact_matrix[gather_idxs[i, 1], gather_idxs[i, 2]] = 1.0
    end
    contact_matrix[1, 1] = 0.0
    bonds_act = model.bond_embedding_layer(
        reshape(contact_matrix, size(contact_matrix)..., 1)
    )
    bonds_act = convert(eltype(pair_activations), bonds_act)
    return pair_activations .+ bonds_act
end

function _embed_template_pair(model::Evoformer, batch, pair_activations, pair_mask, key)
    dtype = eltype(pair_activations)
    key, subkey = split_key(key)
    template_module = TemplateEmbedding(model.config.template, model.global_config)
    templates = batch.templates
    asym_id = batch.token_features.asym_id
    multichain_mask = (asym_id[:, newaxis] .== asym_id[newaxis, :])
    multichain_mask = convert(dtype, multichain_mask)
    template_act = template_module(
        query_embedding=pair_activations,
        templates=templates,
        multichain_mask_2d=multichain_mask,
        padding_mask_2d=pair_mask,
        key=subkey
    )
    return pair_activations .+ template_act, key
end

function _embed_process_msa(model::Evoformer, msa_batch, pair_activations, pair_mask, key, target_feat)
    dtype = eltype(pair_activations)
    msa_batch, key = shuffle_msa(key, msa_batch)
    msa_batch = truncate_msa_batch(msa_batch, model.config.num_msa)
    msa_feat = create_msa_feat(msa_batch)
    msa_feat = convert(dtype, msa_feat)
    msa_activations = model.msa_activations_layer(msa_feat)
    msa_activations = msa_activations .+ model.extra_msa_target_feat_layer(target_feat)[newaxis, :, :]
    msa_mask = convert(dtype, msa_batch.mask)
    evoformer_input = Dict("msa" => msa_activations, "pair" => pair_activations)
    masks = Dict("msa" => msa_mask, "pair" => pair_mask)
    function evoformer_fn(x)
        return EvoformerIteration(
            model.config.msa_stack, model.global_config, name="msa_stack"
        )(
            activations=x,
            masks=masks
        )
    end
    evoformer_output = evoformer_input
    for layer_idx in 1:model.config.msa_stack.num_layer
        evoformer_output = evoformer_fn(evoformer_output)
    end
    return evoformer_output["pair"], key
end

function (model::Evoformer)(batch, prev, target_feat, key)
    @assert model.global_config.bfloat16 in ("all", "none")
    num_residues = size(target_feat, 1)
    @assert size(batch.token_features.aatype) == (num_residues,)
    dtype = model.global_config.bfloat16 == "all" ? Float16 : Float32
    pair_activations, pair_mask = _seq_pair_embedding(model, batch.token_features, target_feat)
    pair_activations = pair_activations .+ model.prev_embedding_layer(
        model.prev_embedding_layer_norm(
            convert(eltype(pair_activations), prev["pair"])
        )
    )
    pair_activations = _relative_encoding(model, batch, pair_activations)
    pair_activations = _embed_bonds(model, batch=batch, pair_activations=pair_activations)
    pair_activations, key = _embed_template_pair(
        model,
        batch=batch,
        pair_activations=pair_activations,
        pair_mask=pair_mask,
        key=key
    )
    pair_activations, key = _embed_process_msa(
        model,
        msa_batch=batch.msa,
        pair_activations=pair_activations,
        pair_mask=pair_mask,
        key=key,
        target_feat=target_feat
    )
    single_activations = model.single_activations_layer(target_feat)
    single_activations = single_activations .+ model.prev_single_embedding_layer(
        model.prev_single_embedding_layer_norm(
            convert(eltype(single_activations), prev["single"])
        )
    )
    function pairformer_fn(x)
        pair_act, single_act = x
        pairformer_iteration = PairFormerIteration(
            model.config.pairformer,
            model.global_config,
            with_single=true,
            name="trunk_pairformer"
        )
        return pairformer_iteration(
            act=pair_act,
            single_act=single_act,
            pair_mask=pair_mask,
            seq_mask=convert(dtype, batch.token_features.mask)
        )
    end
    pair_single_tuple = (pair_activations, single_activations)
    for layer_idx in 1:model.config.pairformer.num_layer
        pair_single_tuple = pairformer_fn(pair_single_tuple)
    end
    pair_activations, single_activations = pair_single_tuple
    @assert size(pair_activations) == (num_residues, num_residues, model.config.pair_channel)
    @assert size(single_activations) == (num_residues, model.config.seq_channel)
    @assert ndims(target_feat) == 2
    @assert size(target_feat, 1) == num_residues
    output = Dict(
        "single" => single_activations,
        "pair" => pair_activations,
        "target_feat" => target_feat
    )
    return output
end
```

```julia
using Flux

function adaptive_layernorm(x, single_cond, name)
    if isnothing(single_cond)
        x = LayerNorm(size(x, ndims(x)), name=name * "layer_norm")(x)
    else
        x = LayerNorm(size(x, ndims(x)), name=name * "layer_norm", affine=false)(x)
        single_cond = LayerNorm(size(single_cond, ndims(single_cond)), name=name * "single_cond_layer_norm", bias=false)(single_cond)
        single_scale = Dense(size(x, ndims(x)), name=name * "single_cond_scale", init=zeros)(single_cond)
        single_bias = Dense(size(x, ndims(x)), name=name * "single_cond_bias", init=zeros)(single_cond)
        x = sigmoid.(single_scale) .* x .+ single_bias
    end
    return x
end

function adaptive_zero_init(x, num_channels, single_cond, global_config, name)
    if isnothing(single_cond)
        output = Dense(num_channels, name=name * "transition2", init=global_config.final_init)(x)
    else
        output = Dense(num_channels, name=name * "transition2")(x)
        cond = Dense(size(output, ndims(output)), name=name * "adaptive_zero_cond", init=zeros, bias=-2.0)(single_cond)
        output = sigmoid.(cond) .* output
    end
    return output
end

function transition_block(x, num_intermediate_factor, global_config; single_cond=nothing, use_glu_kernel=true, name="")
    num_channels = size(x, ndims(x))
    num_intermediates = num_intermediate_factor * num_channels
    x = adaptive_layernorm(x, single_cond, name * "ffw_")
    if use_glu_kernel
        weights, _ = haiku_linear_get_params(
            x,
            num_output=num_intermediates * 2,
            initializer="relu",
            name=name * "ffw_transition1"
        )
        weights = reshape(weights, size(weights, 1), 2, num_intermediates)
        c = gated_linear_unit(x=x, weight=weights, implementation=nothing, activation=swish)
    else
        x_proj = Dense(num_intermediates * 2, name=name * "ffw_transition1", init=relu)(x)
        a, b = split(x_proj, 2, dims=ndims(x_proj))
        c = swish.(a) .* b
    end
    output = adaptive_zero_init(c, num_channels, single_cond, global_config, name * "ffw_")
    return output
end

struct SelfAttentionConfig
    num_head::Int
    key_dim::Union{Int, Nothing}
    value_dim::Union{Int, Nothing}
    SelfAttentionConfig(; num_head=16, key_dim=nothing, value_dim=nothing) = new(num_head, key_dim, value_dim)
end

function self_attention(x, mask, pair_logits, config::SelfAttentionConfig, global_config; single_cond=nothing, name="")
    @assert ndims(mask) == ndims(x) - 1
    bias = (1e9 .* (mask .- 1.0))
    bias = reshape(bias, size(bias)..., 1, 1)
    bias = permutedims(bias, (1, 2, ndims(bias), ndims(bias)-1))
    x = adaptive_layernorm(x, single_cond, name)
    num_channels = size(x, ndims(x))
    key_dim = !isnothing(config.key_dim) ? config.key_dim : num_channels
    value_dim = !isnothing(config.value_dim) ? config.value_dim : num_channels
    num_head = config.num_head
    @assert key_dim % num_head == 0
    @assert value_dim % num_head == 0
    key_dim = div(key_dim, num_head)
    value_dim = div(value_dim, num_head)
    qk_shape = (num_head, key_dim)
    q = Dense(prod(qk_shape), name=name * "q_projection", bias=true)(x)
    q = reshape(q, size(x)[1:end-1]..., qk_shape...)
    k = Dense(prod(qk_shape), name=name * "k_projection", bias=false)(x)
    k = reshape(k, size(x)[1:end-1]..., qk_shape...)
    q = Float32.(q)
    k = Float32.(k)
    bias = Float32.(bias)
    logits = zeros(Float32, size(q)[1:end-1]..., size(k)[1:end-1]...)
    for i in axes(q, 1), j in axes(k, 1)
        for h in 1:num_head
            for c in 1:key_dim
                logits[i, h, j] += q[i, h, c] * k[j, h, c] * key_dim^(-0.5)
            end
        end
    end
    logits = logits .+ bias
    if !isnothing(pair_logits)
        logits = logits .+ pair_logits
    end
    weights = softmax(logits, dims=ndims(logits))
    weights = convert(eltype(x), weights)
    v_shape = (num_head, value_dim)
    v = Dense(prod(v_shape), name=name * "v_projection", bias=false)(x)
    v = reshape(v, size(x)[1:end-1]..., v_shape...)
    weighted_avg = zeros(eltype(x), size(q)[1:end-1]..., num_head, value_dim)
    for i in axes(weights, 1), h in axes(weights, 2)
        for k_idx in axes(weights, 3), c in 1:value_dim
            weighted_avg[i, h, c] += weights[i, h, k_idx] * v[k_idx, h, c]
        end
    end
    weighted_avg = reshape(weighted_avg, size(weighted_avg)[1:end-2]..., num_head * value_dim)
    gate_logits = Dense(num_head * value_dim, name=name * "gating_query", init=zeros, bias=1.0)(x)
    weighted_avg = weighted_avg .* sigmoid.(gate_logits)
    output = adaptive_zero_init(weighted_avg, num_channels, single_cond, global_config, name)
    return output
end

struct TransformerConfig
    attention::SelfAttentionConfig
    num_blocks::Int
    block_remat::Bool
    super_block_size::Int
    num_intermediate_factor::Int
    TransformerConfig(; attention=SelfAttentionConfig(), num_blocks=24, block_remat=false, super_block_size=4, num_intermediate_factor=2) = new(attention, num_blocks, block_remat, super_block_size, num_intermediate_factor)
end

mutable struct Transformer
    config::TransformerConfig
    global_config
    name::String
    pair_input_layer_norm
    pair_logits_projection
end

function Transformer(config::TransformerConfig, global_config; name="transformer")
    Transformer(config, global_config, name, nothing, nothing)
end

function (model::Transformer)(act, mask, single_cond, pair_cond)
    function block(act, pair_logits)
        act = act .+ self_attention(
            act,
            mask,
            pair_logits,
            model.config.attention,
            model.global_config,
            single_cond=single_cond,
            name=model.name
        )
        act = act .+ transition_block(
            act,
            model.config.num_intermediate_factor,
            model.global_config,
            single_cond=single_cond,
            name=model.name
        )
        return act, nothing
    end
    if isnothing(pair_cond)
        pair_act = nothing
    else
        pair_act = model.pair_input_layer_norm(pair_cond)
    end
    @assert model.config.num_blocks % model.config.super_block_size == 0
    num_super_blocks = div(model.config.num_blocks, model.config.super_block_size)
    function super_block(act)
        if isnothing(pair_act)
            pair_logits = nothing
        else
            pair_logits = model.pair_logits_projection(pair_act)
            pair_logits = permutedims(pair_logits, (3, 4, 1, 2))
        end
        for sb_idx in 1:model.config.super_block_size
            act, _ = block(act, isnothing(pair_logits) ? nothing : pair_logits[sb_idx, :, :, :])
        end
        return act
    end
    for super_block_idx in 1:num_super_blocks
        act = super_block(act)
    end
    return act
end

struct CrossAttentionConfig
    num_head::Int
    key_dim::Int
    value_dim::Int
    CrossAttentionConfig(; num_head=4, key_dim=128, value_dim=128) = new(num_head, key_dim, value_dim)
end

function cross_attention(x_q, x_k, mask_q, mask_k, config::CrossAttentionConfig, global_config; pair_logits=nothing, single_cond_q=nothing, single_cond_k=nothing, name="")
    @assert ndims(mask_q) == ndims(x_q) - 1
    @assert ndims(mask_k) == ndims(x_k) - 1
    bias = 1e9 .* (mask_q .- 1.0)
    bias = reshape(bias, size(bias)..., 1)
    bias = permutedims(bias, ntuple(i -> i == ndims(bias) ? ndims(bias) - 1 : i, ndims(bias)))
    bias_q = reshape(bias, size(bias)..., 1)
    bias_k = (mask_k .- 1.0)
    bias_k = reshape(bias_k, size(bias_k)..., 1)
    bias_total = bias_q .* bias_k
    bias_total = 1e9 .* bias_total
    x_q = adaptive_layernorm(x_q, single_cond_q, name * "q")
    x_k = adaptive_layernorm(x_k, single_cond_k, name * "k")
    @assert config.key_dim % config.num_head == 0
    @assert config.value_dim % config.num_head == 0
    key_dim = div(config.key_dim, config.num_head)
    value_dim = div(config.value_dim, config.num_head)
    q = Dense(config.num_head * key_dim, name=name * "q_projection", bias=true)(x_q)
    q = reshape(q, size(q)[1:end-1]..., config.num_head, key_dim)
    k = Dense(config.num_head * key_dim, name=name * "k_projection", bias=false)(x_k)
    k = reshape(k, size(k)[1:end-1]..., config.num_head, key_dim)
    q = Float32.(q)
    k = Float32.(k)
    bias_total = Float32.(bias_total)
    logits = zeros(Float32, size(q)[1:end-1]..., size(k)[1:end-1]...)
    for i in axes(q, 1), j in axes(k, 1)
        for h in 1:config.num_head
            for c in 1:key_dim
                logits[i, h, j] += q[i, h, c] * k[j, h, c] * key_dim^(-0.5)
            end
        end
    end
    logits = logits .+ bias_total
    if !isnothing(pair_logits)
        logits = logits .+ pair_logits
    end
    weights = softmax(logits, dims=ndims(logits))
    weights = convert(eltype(x_q), weights)
    v = Dense(config.num_head * value_dim, name=name * "v_projection", bias=false)(x_k)
    v = reshape(v, size(v)[1:end-1]..., config.num_head, value_dim)
    weighted_avg = zeros(eltype(x_q), size(weights)[1:end-1]..., config.num_head, value_dim)
    for i in axes(weighted_avg, 1), h in 1:config.num_head
        for k_idx in axes(weights, 3), c in 1:value_dim
            weighted_avg[i, h, c] += weights[i, h, k_idx] * v[k_idx, h, c]
        end
    end
    weighted_avg = reshape(weighted_avg, size(weighted_avg)[1:end-2]..., config.num_head * value_dim)
    gate_logits = Dense(config.num_head * value_dim, name=name * "gating_query", bias=1.0, init=zeros)(x_q)
    weighted_avg = weighted_avg .* sigmoid.(gate_logits)
    output = adaptive_zero_init(weighted_avg, size(x_q, ndims(x_q)), single_cond_q, global_config, name)
    return output
end

struct CrossAttTransformerConfig
    num_intermediate_factor::Int
    num_blocks::Int
    attention::CrossAttentionConfig
    CrossAttTransformerConfig(; num_intermediate_factor=2, num_blocks=3, attention=CrossAttentionConfig()) = new(num_intermediate_factor, num_blocks, attention)
end

mutable struct CrossAttTransformer
    config::CrossAttTransformerConfig
    global_config
    name::String
    pair_input_layer_norm
    pair_logits_projection
end

function CrossAttTransformer(config::CrossAttTransformerConfig, global_config; name="transformer")
    CrossAttTransformer(config, global_config, name, nothing, nothing)
end

function (model::CrossAttTransformer)(queries_act, queries_mask, queries_to_keys, keys_mask, queries_single_cond, keys_single_cond, pair_cond)
    function block(queries_act, pair_logits)
        keys_act = convert(queries_to_keys, queries_act)
        queries_act = queries_act .+ cross_attention(
            x_q=queries_act,
            x_k=keys_act,
            mask_q=queries_mask,
            mask_k=keys_mask,
            config=model.config.attention,
            global_config=model.global_config,
            pair_logits=pair_logits,
            single_cond_q=queries_single_cond,
            single_cond_k=keys_single_cond,
            name=model.name
        )
        queries_act = queries_act .+ transition_block(
            queries_act,
            model.config.num_intermediate_factor,
            model.global_config,
            single_cond=queries_single_cond,
            name=model.name
        )
        return queries_act, nothing
    end
    pair_act = model.pair_input_layer_norm(pair_cond)
    pair_logits = model.pair_logits_projection(pair_act)
    pair_logits = permutedims(pair_logits, (4, 1, 5, 2, 3))
    for block_idx in 1:model.config.num_blocks
        queries_act, _ = block(queries_act, pair_logits[block_idx, :, :, :, :])
    end
    return queries_act
end
```

```julia
using DataStructures

struct ResIdMapping
    old_res_ids::Array
    new_res_ids::Array
end

function _count_symmetric_chains(struc)
    chain_res_name_sequence_from_chain_id = chain_res_name_sequence(
        struc,
        include_missing_residues=true,
        fix_non_standard_polymer_res=false
    )
    counts_for_chain_res_name_sequence = counter(values(chain_res_name_sequence_from_chain_id))
    chain_symmetric_count = Dict()
    for (chain_id, chain_res_name) in chain_res_name_sequence_from_chain_id
        chain_symmetric_count[chain_id] = counts_for_chain_res_name_sequence[chain_res_name]
    end
    return chain_symmetric_count
end

function has_nonsymmetric_bonds_on_symmetric_polymer_chains(struc, polymer_ligand_bonds)
    try
        _get_polymer_dim(polymer_ligand_bonds)
    catch
        return true
    end
    if _has_non_polymer_ligand_ptm_bonds(polymer_ligand_bonds)
        return true
    end
    if _has_multiple_polymers_bonded_to_one_ligand(polymer_ligand_bonds)
        return true
    end
    combined_struc, _ = _combine_polymer_ligand_ptm_chains(struc, polymer_ligand_bonds)
    struc = filter(struc, chain_type=POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES)
    combined_struc = filter(combined_struc, chain_type=POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES)
    return _count_symmetric_chains(struc) != _count_symmetric_chains(combined_struc)
end

function _has_non_polymer_ligand_ptm_bonds(polymer_ligand_bonds)
    for (start_chain_type, end_chain_type) in polymer_ligand_bonds.chain_type
        if (start_chain_type in POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES && end_chain_type in LIGAND_CHAIN_TYPES)
            continue
        elseif (start_chain_type in LIGAND_CHAIN_TYPES && end_chain_type in POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES)
            continue
        else
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function _combine_polymer_ligand_ptm_chains(struc, polymer_ligand_bonds)
    if !_has_only_single_bond_from_each_chain(polymer_ligand_bonds)
        if _has_multiple_ligands_bonded_to_one_polymer(polymer_ligand_bonds)
            polymer_ligand_bonds = _sort_polymer_ligand_bonds_by_polymer_chain_and_res_id(polymer_ligand_bonds)
        else
            error("Code cannot handle multiple bonds from one chain unless its several ligands bonded to a polymer.")
        end
    end
    res_id_mappings_for_bond_chain_pair = Dict()
    for ((start_chain_id, end_chain_id), (start_chain_type, end_chain_type)) in zip(polymer_ligand_bonds.chain_id, polymer_ligand_bonds.chain_type)
        poly_info, ligand_info = _get_polymer_and_ligand_chain_ids_and_types(
            start_chain_id, end_chain_id, start_chain_type, end_chain_type
        )
        polymer_chain_id, polymer_chain_type = poly_info
        ligand_chain_id, _ = ligand_info
        ligand_res_ids = filter(struc, chain_id=ligand_chain_id).res_id
        new_res_ids = ligand_res_ids .+ length(struc.all_residues[polymer_chain_id])
        res_id_mappings_for_bond_chain_pair[(polymer_chain_id, ligand_chain_id)] = ResIdMapping(old_res_ids=ligand_res_ids, new_res_ids=new_res_ids)
        chain_groups = []
        chain_group_ids = []
        chain_group_types = []
        for (chain_id, chain_type) in zip(struc.chains_table.id, struc.chains_table.type)
            if chain_id == ligand_chain_id
                continue
            elseif chain_id == polymer_chain_id
                push!(chain_groups, [polymer_chain_id, ligand_chain_id])
                push!(chain_group_ids, polymer_chain_id)
                push!(chain_group_types, polymer_chain_type)
            else
                push!(chain_groups, [chain_id])
                push!(chain_group_ids, chain_id)
                push!(chain_group_types, chain_type)
            end
        end
        struc = merge_chains(
            struc,
            chain_groups=chain_groups,
            chain_group_ids=chain_group_ids,
            chain_group_types=chain_group_types
        )
    end
    return struc, res_id_mappings_for_bond_chain_pair
end

function _has_only_single_bond_from_each_chain(polymer_ligand_bonds)
    chain_ids = []
    for chains in polymer_ligand_bonds.chain_id
        append!(chain_ids, chains)
    end
    if length(chain_ids) != length(unique(chain_ids))
        return false
    end
    return true
end

function _get_polymer_and_ligand_chain_ids_and_types(start_chain_id, end_chain_id, start_chain_type, end_chain_type)
    if (start_chain_type in POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES && end_chain_type in LIGAND_CHAIN_TYPES)
        return (start_chain_id, start_chain_type), (end_chain_id, end_chain_type)
    elseif (start_chain_type in LIGAND_CHAIN_TYPES && end_chain_type in POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES)
        return (end_chain_id, end_chain_type), (start_chain_id, start_chain_type)
    else
        error("This code only handles PTM-bonds from polymer chain to ligands.")
    end
end

function _get_polymer_dim(polymer_ligand_bonds)
    start_chain_types = []
    end_chain_types = []
    for (start_chain_type, end_chain_type) in polymer_ligand_bonds.chain_type
        push!(start_chain_types, start_chain_type)
        push!(end_chain_types, end_chain_type)
    end
    if issubset(Set(start_chain_types), Set(POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES)) && issubset(Set(end_chain_types), Set(LIGAND_CHAIN_TYPES))
        return 0
    elseif issubset(Set(start_chain_types), Set(LIGAND_CHAIN_TYPES)) && issubset(Set(end_chain_types), Set(POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES))
        return 1
    else
        error("Polymer and ligand dimensions are not consistent within the structure.")
    end
end

function _has_multiple_ligands_bonded_to_one_polymer(polymer_ligand_bonds)
    polymer_dim = _get_polymer_dim(polymer_ligand_bonds)
    polymer_chain_ids = [chains[polymer_dim + 1] for chains in polymer_ligand_bonds.chain_id]
    if length(polymer_chain_ids) != length(unique(polymer_chain_ids))
        return true
    end
    return false
end

function _has_multiple_polymers_bonded_to_one_ligand(polymer_ligand_bonds)
    polymer_dim = _get_polymer_dim(polymer_ligand_bonds)
    ligand_dim = 1 - polymer_dim
    ligand_chain_ids = [chains[ligand_dim + 1] for chains in polymer_ligand_bonds.chain_id]
    if length(ligand_chain_ids) != length(unique(ligand_chain_ids))
        return true
    end
    return false
end

function _sort_polymer_ligand_bonds_by_polymer_chain_and_res_id(polymer_ligand_bonds)
    polymer_dim = _get_polymer_dim(polymer_ligand_bonds)
    polymer_chain_ids = [chains[polymer_dim + 1] for chains in polymer_ligand_bonds.chain_id]
    polymer_res_ids = [res[polymer_dim + 1] for res in polymer_ligand_bonds.res_id]
    polymer_chain_and_res_id = zip(polymer_chain_ids, polymer_res_ids)
    sorted_indices = sortperm(collect(polymer_chain_and_res_id))
    return polymer_ligand_bonds[sorted_indices]
end
```

```julia
    profile = compute_msa_profile(msa=msa, num_residue_types=num_restypes)
    return Dict(
        "profile" => Float32.(profile),
        "deletion_mean" => mean(deletion_matrix, dims=1)
    )
end

function fix_template_features(template_features::FeatureDict, num_res::Int)
    if size(template_features["template_aatype"], 1) == 0
        template_features = empty_template_features(num_res)
    else
        template_release_timestamp = [
            _get_timestamp(String(x))
            for x in template_features["template_release_date"]
        ]
        dense_atom_indices = PROTEIN_AATYPE_DENSE_ATOM_TO_ATOM37[template_features["template_aatype"] .+ 1, :]
        atom_mask = zeros(size(template_features["template_all_atom_masks"]))
        for i in axes(dense_atom_indices, 1)
            for j in axes(dense_atom_indices, 2)
                idx = dense_atom_indices[i, j]
                atom_mask[i, j, :] = template_features["template_all_atom_masks"][i, idx, :]
            end
        end
        atom_positions = zeros(size(template_features["template_all_atom_positions"]))
        for i in axes(dense_atom_indices, 1)
            for j in axes(dense_atom_indices, 2)
                idx = dense_atom_indices[i, j]
                atom_positions[i, j, :] = template_features["template_all_atom_positions"][i, idx, :]
            end
        end
        atom_positions = atom_positions .* atom_mask[:, :, 1:1]
        template_features = Dict(
            "template_aatype" => template_features["template_aatype"],
            "template_atom_mask" => Int32.(atom_mask),
            "template_atom_positions" => Float32.(atom_positions),
            "template_domain_names" => convert(Array{Any}, template_features["template_domain_names"]),
            "template_release_timestamp" => Float32.(template_release_timestamp)
        )
    end
    return template_features
end

function empty_template_features(num_res::Int)
    template_features = Dict(
        "template_aatype" => reshape(zeros(Int32, num_res), 1, num_res),
        "template_atom_mask" => reshape(zeros(Int32, num_res, NUM_DENSE), 1, num_res, NUM_DENSE),
        "template_atom_positions" => reshape(zeros(Float32, num_res, NUM_DENSE, 3), 1, num_res, NUM_DENSE, 3),
        "template_domain_names" => [b""],
        "template_release_timestamp" => [0.0f0]
    )
    return template_features
end

function _get_timestamp(date_str::String)
    dt = DateTime(date_str)
    dt = ZonedDateTime(dt, tz"UTC")
    return datetime2unix(dt)
end
```
